patch_list: Removes the gift icon in the top right of the home screen that opens the Events page.
Removes the Instant Plays history section from the top of My games.
Removes the "Popular Instant Plays categories" row from the home screen.
Removes the "Recommended for you" row from the home screen.
Removes the "Top instant plays" row from the home screen.

Experimental. Shows your play history in the gamer profile, computed on the device from Android's usage data instead of Samsung's server, and stops account-only requests to Samsung's server that fail without a Samsung account. Requires usa…

Experimental. Opens Gaming Hub without the mandatory Samsung account sign-in. Required for any patched Gaming Hub, because Samsung account sign-in only works with the original Samsung signature. Features that need an account will not work.
Fills My games with installed apps that Android marks as games. Required for any patched Gaming Hub, because Samsung's game service refuses apps that are not signed by Samsung.
